newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Average yield in Slovak 4-wk T-bill at 13.96 pct.
newsitem.headline: Average yield in Slovak 4-wk T-bill at 13.96 pct.

text.p: Average yield at the Slovka Finance Ministry's auction of four-week treasury bills hit 13.957 percent, the central bank said in a statement on Wednesday.
At the last auction of four-week T-bills on February 5, the ministry rejected all bids totalling 127 million crowns.
Average yield at the last successful auction of four-week T-bills on January 8 hit 13.64 percent, up from 12.55 percent in the previous auction of similar bills on December 30.
The ministry does not announce the amount of bills on offer at its auctions. The next auction of the finance ministry T-bills, with a maturity of three months, is scheduled for February 19.
